description: Save a private invoice DRAFT (not sent, not payable) for an existing customer_id: line items with quantity × unit price, a due date, and only an explicit discount or tax the merchant stated. Invoices are in USDT, the settlement asset: if the merchant priced in another currency, ask for the USDT amounts or offer a payment link; never convert. Never invent a tax rate. Resolve a relative due date ("next Friday") with get_business_profile's today and confirm the resulting date.

create_another.description: true only when the merchant deliberately wants a second record identical to one just created (e.g. two identical sales). Never to retry an error.

customer_id.description: From search_customers or create_customer. Never a name.

discount.description: Only if the merchant asked for one.

due_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD in the business time zone; today or later.

idempotency_key.description: Optional, advanced: your own key for this exact request. Leave it out normally: a retry of an unresolved request is resumed automatically.

memo.description: Optional note shown on the invoice.

tax.description: Only a tax the merchant explicitly named, with its rate. Never infer one.

name: create_invoice_draft
title: Create invoice draft
